label: Straight Jetted Pocket
description: The straight jetted pocket sets its mouth dead level across the hip and finishes it with two narrow strips of cloth — the jets — running above and below a clean horizontal slit, leaving the jacket face otherwise unbroken. Both jets are cut to the same width along their entire length and stop at exactly the same point at each end, so the opening reads as one precise horizontal line. Nothing covers the slit, so the quality of the jetting is fully exposed: the strips lie perfectly flat against the cloth, without drawing or puckering at the corners.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
